ghats.name: Patalaganga Bathing Ghat
ghats.description: Historic stone steps laid by 14th-century Reddy ruler Anavema Reddy to reach Krishna River (Patalaganga). Accessible via ~500 stone steps or the AP Tourism Ropeway / Cable Car.

significance: Srisailam is home to 6 crore holy rivers and 40 holy streams. Taking a holy dip in the sacred waters of Patalaganga near Krishna River washes away all sins, grants merits of Ashvamedha Yagas, and frees devotees from the cycle of rebirth.
safety_rules: Always stay within protective iron railings. Deep waters and strong undercurrents exist. When Srisailam Dam gates are opened, bathing directly in deep river channels is restricted. Ropeway / Cable Car available for senior citizens.
